contract: Pure bounded v1 recipe package as decoded plain JSON data: exact name, opaque version, canonical SHA-256 content identity, declarative needs and permissions, unchanged ready graph and settings descriptor, and bounded decoded skill frontmatter and Markdown. Encode returns the exact original map; fixed redacted refusals, no loading or authority.
limits: Trusted source pinning and host-approved schema complexity remain host Needs; a matching content digest authenticates nobody and byte caps do not bound schema compiler work.
Decoded frontmatter only: no raw YAML or SKILL.md syntax validation, folder provenance, file/archive reader, script execution, registry lookup or bundled assets.
No settings values, secret resolution, authorization, approval, runtime trust assignment, prompt construction or claim that package bodies fit a loaded request.
Finite named scenarios, not a universal proof; forged checked internals are outside the interface. Telemetry is used only by tests.

grounding.claim: Named groups manifest_identity_and_roundtrip, ready_graph_and_settings_reuse, skill_refusal_before_load, trust_and_bounds and redaction_and_no_effects exercise content mutations, exact caps, actual ready API calls, fixed refusals, captured logs and traced effect absence, and the checked example. Temporary production mutations are negative controls; finite tests only.

Pinned compact scalar JSON encoding; object keys are recursively sorted by UTF-8 binary order and list order is retained. Ready RecipeGraph and RecipeConfig interfaces own graph/schema validation unchanged.
OTP crypto.hash/2 supplies SHA-256 over canonical JSON iodata; no authentication is inferred.

The host independently resolves and pins a trusted package source, supplies approved schema complexity and secret-free declarations, and preserves caller-held checked values. Later loading owns total request bytes and runtime trust.

telemetry.contract: Pure operands; no logs or telemetry emitted.

config.contract: Intrinsic decoded data and fixed v1 bounds, no selectable settings.
